key: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
english: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Usa la Antigravity CLI instalada en este Mac y la cuenta de Google con la que ha iniciado sesión; las solicitudes cuentan para los límites de esa cuenta. Ejecuta `agy` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión; `agy models` muestra los id de modelo. Esfuerzo: low, medium, high o max, solo para un id de modelo sin nivel propio (un modelo que termina en -high, -medium o -low lo ignora). Las ejecuciones usan el proyecto hearsay-notes de agy, cuyas reglas de denegación no dejan al modelo ninguna herramienta salvo la búsqueda web, y la conversación de cada ejecución se elimina después del historial de agy.

key: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this PC and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
english: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this PC and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
comment: Settings > AI caption, the Mac's text with "this PC" for "this Mac". Windows only.
translation: Usa la Antigravity CLI instalada en este PC y la cuenta de Google con la que ha iniciado sesión; las solicitudes cuentan para los límites de esa cuenta. Ejecuta `agy` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión; `agy models` muestra los id de modelo. Esfuerzo: low, medium, high o max, solo para un id de modelo sin nivel propio (un modelo que termina en -high, -medium o -low lo ignora). Las ejecuciones usan el proyecto hearsay-notes de agy, cuyas reglas de denegación no dejan al modelo ninguna herramienta salvo la búsqueda web, y la conversación de cada ejecución se elimina después del historial de agy.

english: Uses the Copilot CLI installed on this PC and its own login. Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in. "auto" lets Copilot pick the model.
comment: Settings > AI caption, the Mac's text with "this PC" for "this Mac". Windows only.
translation: Usa la Copilot CLI instalada en este PC y su propio inicio de sesión. Ejecuta `copilot` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión. "auto" deja que Copilot elija el modelo.

key: While recording, the notification area icon turns red and its tooltip shows the elapsed time. When off, the icon stays the same.
english: While recording, the notification area icon turns red and its tooltip shows the elapsed time. When off, the icon stays the same.
comment: Settings > Window caption, the Mac's menu bar text: the Windows notification area cannot show text next to the icon. Windows only.
translation: Durante la grabación, el icono del área de notificación se vuelve rojo y su descripción emergente muestra el tiempo transcurrido. Si está desactivado, el icono no cambia.

key: wav, m4a, mp3, aac, wma, flac, or the audio track of mp4 / mov
english: wav, m4a, mp3, aac, wma, flac, or the audio track of mp4 / mov
comment: File tab: the file types the drop target accepts, the Mac's list with what Windows can read. Keep the extensions as they are. Windows only.
translation: wav, m4a, mp3, aac, wma, flac o la pista de audio de mp4 / mov

key: This computer transcribes on its processor (CPU): after you stop, the transcript takes about 1.5 to 3.5 times as long as the recording.
english: This computer transcribes on its processor (CPU): after you stop, the transcript takes about 1.5 to 3.5 times as long as the recording.
comment: Record tab notice before the first recording when transcription runs on the processor (no Vulkan graphics). Windows only.
translation: Este equipo transcribe con su procesador (CPU): al detener, la transcripción tarda entre 1,5 y 3,5 veces lo que dura la grabación.

comment: Shortcut display: the Control key, as Windows menus name it in this language (German Strg). Windows only.
Shortcut display: the Alt key, as Windows menus name it. Windows only.
Shortcut display: the Shift key, as Windows menus name it in this language (German Umschalt, Spanish Mayús). Windows only.
Shortcut display: the Windows logo key. Windows only.

key: Press a combination with Ctrl, Alt, or Win. Esc cancels; Backspace restores the default.
english: Press a combination with Ctrl, Alt, or Win. Esc cancels; Backspace restores the default.
comment: Shortcut recorder tooltip while listening. Use the key names Windows uses in this language. Windows only.
translation: Pulsa una combinación con Ctrl, Alt o Win. Esc para cancelar; Retroceso restaura el valor predeterminado.

comment: Shortcut recorder hint. Use the key names Windows uses in this language. Windows only.

key: Already used for Start / Stop recording.
english: Already used for Start / Stop recording.
comment: Shortcut recorder hint: the Pause shortcut was set to the Start / Stop one. Windows only.
translation: Ya se usa para Iniciar / Detener grabación.

comment: Shortcut recorder hint: the Start / Stop shortcut was set to the Pause one. Windows only.
translation: Ya se usa para Pausar / Reanudar.

key: Already used for Stop & Start Next.
english: Already used for Stop & Start Next.
comment: Shortcut recorder hint: the Start / Stop or Pause shortcut was set to the Stop & Start Next one. Windows only.
translation: Ya se usa para Detener e iniciar la siguiente.

key: %@ is already used by another app or Windows.
english: %@ is already used by another app or Windows.
comment: Shortcut recorder hint. %@ is a shortcut such as Ctrl+Alt+Win+R. Windows only.
translation: %@ ya lo usa otra app o Windows.

key: Windows does not accept this shortcut (error %d).
english: Windows does not accept this shortcut (error %d).
comment: Shortcut recorder hint. %d is a system error number. Windows only.

key: %@ cannot take a transcript this long on Windows: the command line would be %@ characters, and Windows allows %@. Use Claude Code, Codex, or an HTTP provider for long meetings.
english: %1$@ cannot take a transcript this long on Windows: the command line would be %2$@ characters, and Windows allows %3$@. Use Claude Code, Codex, or an HTTP provider for long meetings.
comment: Meeting notes error when the prompt would not fit on the command line (Copilot and Antigravity take it as an argument). %1$@ is a CLI name, %2$@ and %3$@ are character counts with digit grouping. Keep the product names. Windows only.
translation: %1$@ no admite una transcripción tan larga en Windows: la línea de comandos tendría %2$@ caracteres y Windows permite %3$@. Para reuniones largas, usa Claude Code, Codex o un proveedor HTTP.

comment: Settings > AI login status line: %1$@ is the CLI's own status output (as the CLI prints it, not translated), %2$@ the 'Run … once in Terminal to log in.' hint. The Mac joins the two the same way. Windows only.

key: Windows is running Hearsay straight from the zip file. Extract the zip to a folder you can write to, open Hearsay from there, then check for updates again.
english: Windows is running Hearsay straight from the zip file. Extract the zip to a folder you can write to, open Hearsay from there, then check for updates again.
comment: Update install error: Hearsay was opened from inside the downloaded zip file (Explorer runs it from a temporary copy). The Mac's disk image text for Windows. Windows only.
translation: Windows está ejecutando Hearsay directamente desde el archivo ZIP. Extrae el archivo ZIP en una carpeta en la que puedas escribir, abre Hearsay desde allí y vuelve a buscar actualizaciones.

key: This copy of Hearsay is not in its own app folder, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
english: This copy of Hearsay is not in its own app folder, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
comment: Update install error: the running Hearsay.exe is not in a folder of its own. The Mac's 'not an app bundle' text for Windows. Windows only.
translation: Esta copia de Hearsay no está en su propia carpeta de app, por lo que no puede actualizarse sola. Descarga la nueva versión desde la página de la versión.

key: Hearsay cannot write to the folder %@. Move the Hearsay folder to a folder you can write to, open it from there, then check for updates again.
english: Hearsay cannot write to the folder %@. Move the Hearsay folder to a folder you can write to, open it from there, then check for updates again.
comment: Update install error. %@ is a folder path. The Mac's text without the Applications folder. Windows only.
translation: Hearsay no puede escribir en la carpeta %@. Traslada la carpeta de Hearsay a una carpeta en la que puedas escribir, ábrelo desde allí y vuelve a buscar actualizaciones.

key: The zip file could not be extracted: %@
english: The zip file could not be extracted: %@
comment: Update verification error. %@ is the system's error message. The Mac's disk image text for Windows. Windows only.
translation: No se ha podido extraer el archivo ZIP: %@

key: The zip file should contain one Hearsay.exe but contains %lld.
english: The zip file should contain one Hearsay.exe but contains %lld.
comment: Update verification error. %lld is a number of Hearsay.exe files. Keep Hearsay.exe. Windows only.
translation: El archivo ZIP debería contener un Hearsay.exe, pero contiene %lld.

key: The new version is signed by %@, not by %@ like this copy of Hearsay.
english: The new version is signed by %1$@, not by %2$@ like this copy of Hearsay.
comment: Update verification error. %1$@ is the new version's certificate subject, %2$@ the running copy's (either may be 'unknown'). Windows only.
translation: La nueva versión está firmada por %1$@, no por %2$@ como esta copia de Hearsay.

key: The new app has the product name %@, not Hearsay.
english: The new app has the product name %@, not Hearsay.
comment: Update verification error. %@ is the product name in the new Hearsay.exe (or 'none'). The Mac's bundle identifier text for Windows. Windows only.
translation: La nueva app tiene el nombre de producto %@, no Hearsay.

key: The release has no Windows zip file or checksum list.
english: The release has no Windows zip file or checksum list.
comment: Update error: the GitHub release lacks the Windows download. The Mac's disk image text for Windows. Windows only.
translation: La versión no incluye un archivo ZIP para Windows o una lista de sumas de comprobación.

key: The last update could not be installed. Hearsay is still the previous version.
english: The last update could not be installed. Hearsay is still the previous version.
comment: Shown after Hearsay reopens when the update helper failed to replace the app. Windows only.
translation: No se ha podido instalar la última actualización. Hearsay sigue en la versión anterior.

key: Could not load the speech model: %@
english: Could not load the speech model: %@
comment: Transcription error when whisper.cpp cannot load the model file. %@ is the technical reason (English). Windows only (the Mac shows the decoder's error as it is).
translation: No se ha podido cargar el modelo de voz: %@

comment: Error detail after 'API call failed: …' or 'The download failed: …' when the server did not answer in time (the Mac shows the system's text). Windows only.
translation: Se ha agotado el tiempo de espera de la solicitud.

comment: Error detail after 'The download failed: …'. %lld is an HTTP status code such as 404. Windows only.
Inserted into update errors for a version or certificate Hearsay could not read ('The new app is version unknown, not 1.2.0.'). Windows only.
Inserted into an update error when the new Hearsay.exe has no product name ('The new app has the product name none, not Hearsay.'). Windows only.
Button (a verb) of the "Microsoft Teams meeting started" dialog: start recording in the chosen language. Not the Record tab's name. Windows only.
